Marvel Unlimited is the premier subscription service to access over 30,000 digital comics.

Marvel Unlimited features all of your favorite characters from Marvel movies, TV shows, and video games. Read the comic books that inspired your favorite super heroes and villains on the big screen! Start your free 7-day trial today!

Experience the all-new digital comic format, Marvel’s Infinity Comics available exclusively on Marvel Unlimited. Featuring in-universe stories from top creators told in visionary vertical format, designed for your device.

Read comics and stories about Spider-Man, Iron Man, Captain America, Captain Marvel, The Avengers, Thor, Hulk, the X-Men, the Guardians of the Galaxy, Star Wars, Doctor Strange, Deadpool, Thanos, Mysterio, Ant-Man, The Wasp, Black Panther, Wolverine, Hawkeye, Wanda Maximoff, Jessica Jones, the Defenders, Luke Cage, Venom, and many more!

Wondering where to start? Check out endless reading guides curated by Marvel experts to guide you through the last 80 years of the Marvel Universe. Read about comic events that inspired the movies such as the Spider-Verse, Civil War, Thanos and the Infinity Gauntlet, and even Star Wars!

Unlimited downloads allows you to read as many comics as you want offline and on-the-go! Follow your favorite characters, creators and series and get notified when new issues come out! Marvel Unlimited is available on mobile phones, tablets, and anywhere you can access the web.

Key Features:
• Access over 30,000 Marvel comics at your fingertips
• Infinity Comics, in-universe stories from top creators designed for your device
• Endless reading guides
• Unlimited downloads to read anywhere
• Personalized comic book recommendations
• Sync progress across devices
• New comics and old classics added every week
• No commitments. Cancel online at any time.

Choose from three different Marvel Unlimited comic subscription plans as follows:
• Monthly – Our most popular plan!
• Annual – Great savings!
• Annual Plus – Get a new, exclusive merchandise kit each year you’re a member! (US Only)

Subscription via iTunes:

Download the app and sign up for your free one-week trial to start reading. If you are enjoying your free trial, do nothing and your membership will automatically renew each month. You can cancel at any time. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the then-current subscription period. Your payment method associated with your iTunes account will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal, as stated above, within 24 hours prior to the end of the then-current billing period. You can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

Before you download this app, please consider that it may include or support advertising, some of which the Walt Disney Family of Companies may target to your interests. You may choose to control targeted advertising within mobile applications by using your mobile device settings (for example, by re-setting your device's advertising identifier and/or opting out of interest-based ads).

Can you survive?

Battle hordes of enemies and vicious bosses from around the DC universe in this incredibly challenging roguelite. Play as Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman or many other Super Heroes and face off against powerful Super-Villains.

Each map increases in difficulty. Level up your characters and unlock new ones. Mix and match different super abilities and evolve them to get more powerful. Unique Ultimates change your gameplay experience and help you survive.

Also catch the DC Heroes United interactive series, with the first seven episodes already available in the app, and decisions that will impact what happens in the series and what items you as a community will unlock in the game.

Features
- Face off against hordes of enemies
- Unlock powerful heroes and abilities through experience and in-app purchases
- Take on Bane, Poison Ivy, and many more across Gotham, Metropolis, and other locations
- New heroes, weapons, power-ups and maps added weekly

Join us in DC Heroes United and shape the course of legends. Are you ready to answer the call to heroism and shape the future of your favorite characters?

Welcome to MARVEL SNAP, the Mobile Game of the Year Award Winner, loved by millions of players worldwide. Build your deck and harness the power of different abilities from MARVEL Super Heroes or Villains, and outsmart your opponent in 3 minutes or less with a winning strategy. This fast-paced CCG has weekly updates and cross-platform play, making the card game easy to pick up but hard to put down, whether you play on PC or mobile. 

The innovative "SNAP" is a unique mechanic in the game that lets you raise the stakes during a match and apply pressure on your opponent. If you think you have a winning hand, use the 'SNAP' mechanic to double down and potentially double your rewards.

Quickly become the master of the multiverse when you download the fast–paced MARVEL SNAP card game! 

MARVEL SNAP APP FEATURES:

PLAY 3-MINUTE GAMES & WIN IN MARVEL SNAP
- Every game lasts 3 minutes. We cut the fluff to focus on quick games and pure strategy!
- Each player begins with a FREE starter deck that helps you get started on your journey. There are no energy barriers, no ads, and no limits to your play!
- Play card games at your own pace, unlock your favorite MARVEL characters, and discover hundreds of new ones as you earn new cards.
- “SNAP” mechanic strategy - Apply pressure to your opponents using this innovative feature, and potentially double your rewards.

MARVEL CCG WITH VARIETY
- This MARVEL-themed card game is designed so that every match feels different. 
- Play with cards at 50+ different locations from across the MARVEL Universe, each with iconic game-changing abilities. 
- From Asgard to Wakanda, new locations are introduced regularly to put your creative problem-solving skills to the test.
- Weekly updates: Access new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly.

CROSS-PLATFORM PLAY 
- Available on both mobile AND Desktop PC. 
- Play anywhere, at any time, when you register your account.
- Your progress stays with you across different platforms. 

BUILD YOUR DECK & COLLECT CARDS
- Each card in your deck is a unique character from the MARVEL Multiverse. 
- Collect, mix, and match hundreds of MARVEL hero and villain art variants from the entire MARVEL Universe—and beyond. You might have a classic comic-inspired Iron Man card, but do you also have the Chibi, 8-bit, and Cartoon variants?

I AM GROOT
I am Groot. I AM Groot. I am GROOT. I am Groot? I am Groot. I AM GROOT! I am GROOT. I am Groot? 

DAILY, WEEKLY, & MONTHLY UPDATES
MARVEL SNAP stays fresh and exciting with new cards, new locations, new cosmetics, new season passes, new ranked seasons, new challenges, new missions, and new events regularly. You don't have to wait months for updates! 

What are you waiting for? This strategy CCG game only takes a few minutes to learn and 3-minutes to play. Earn the most power in your location and use a winning strategy to dominate the battle. Download today to see why MARVEL SNAP has won multiple 'Mobile Game of the Year' awards!

Marvel Contest of Champions is the ultimate arcade fighting RPG game with intense action, powerful combos, epic quests & customization. Collect and battle with over 350 Champions, including your favorite Marvel Super Heroes and Villains like Spider-Man, Iron Man, Hulk, Daredevil, Doctor Doom, Wolverine  & more!

Step into fast-paced 1v1 combat where skill is everything. Master precise dodges, well-timed blocks, and powerful combo chains as you fight your way through an epic Marvel storyline. Unleash signature Special Attacks and dominate real-time battles packed with action.

Assemble your Marvel team and begin your quest to become the ultimate Champion!

THE ULTIMATE MARVEL FIGHTING GAME
Dynamic Real-Time Action & Fights – Dodge, block, and chain combos in fast-paced, action-packed Marvel battles.
Signature Special Moves – Unleash powerful Special Attacks that are unique to every Champion and unlock their Signature Abilities such as Spider-Man’s Spider-Sense, Wolverine’s Cellular Regeneration and Quicksilver’s Super Speed. 
Strategic Action Fighting Styles – Use class advantages and counters to defeat opponents.

OVER 350+ MARVEL HEROES
• Captain America vs. Iron Man! Hulk vs. Wolverine! Spider-Man vs. Deadpool! Professor X vs. Magneto! The greatest battles in Marvel history are in your hands!
• The Collector has summoned you to fight with the biggest Super Heroes & Super Villains from the Marvel Universe!
• Experience the ultimate free-to-play action Super Hero fighting game on your mobile device

BUILD, CUSTOMIZE & UPGRADE YOUR ULTIMATE TEAM OF CHAMPIONS:
• Epic Marvel Action: Assemble a mighty team of Super Heroes and Villains, including Champions from the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, Guardians of the Galaxy and more!
• RPG Fighting Game: Collect, level up, and manage your teams of heroes and villains wisely to receive synergy bonuses based on their relationship
• Team Customization: Pair up Venom with other Arachnid Hunters such as Vulture or Green Goblin or make a team of Guardians of the Galaxy for a team affiliation bonus.
• The more powerful the Champion, the better their stats, abilities and special moves will be!

QUEST, FIGHT AND BATTLE:
• Journey through an exciting storyline full of action in classic Marvel storytelling fashion!
• Embark on action-packed quests to defeat villains like Kang and Thanos and stop a mysterious cosmic threat from destroying the Marvel Universe.
• Fight Marvel heroes and villains across iconic locations like the Avengers Tower, Hell’s Kitchen, Asgard, the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, and more.
• Explore dynamic quest maps and jump into action-packed battles with fighting game controls designed specifically for mobile.


PLAY WITH OTHERS:
• Team up with friends and Summoners to build a powerful Alliance
• Test your Alliance’s strength and fight Alliances worldwide in Alliance Wars.
• Challenge other Summoners in Battlegrounds for bragging rights!
• Partner with another Summoner and take on multiple zones of challenges in Incursions

The fate of the world is in your hands playing MARVEL Strike Force! Team up with Marvel super heroes and super villains in this action-packed, visually stunning free-to-play game for iPhone or iPad. Defend Earth against Marvel's legendary threats by building teams of Marvel characters from every corner of the multiverse like Mister Fantastic, Loki, Venom, Spider-Man, Captain America, Iron Man, and more. Inject hero blood into your veins by dominating the competition in a slew of game modes ranging from Alliance team-ups to single player rumbles. The world is watching… answer the call in MARVEL Strike Force!


ASSEMBLE YOUR SQUAD
Form a RPG squad of powerful MARVEL Super Heroes and Super Villains in a fight to save the universe. Mix and match characters from all corners of the multiverse for an experience unlike other single player games.

STRENGTH THROUGH EVOLUTION
Outfit and upgrade your Marvel Super Heroes and Super Villains to become stronger than ever before. Strengthen characters for specific single player game modes or to dominate across every battle.

STRATEGIC DOMINATION
Who you bring to the fight matters in this super hero game. Pair up specific heroes and villains in squads to form synergies and take out enemies. Utilize RPG fight tactics during 5v5 battles to vanquish the greatest villains of the Marvel Universe.

EPIC COMBAT
Experience groundbreaking RPG gameplay cinematics in this super hero game as your squads unleash dynamic chain combos with a single tap.

STUNNING VISUALS
Play through a visually stunning mobile game experience leading your favorite Marvel characters in this super hero game. The world of Marvel has never looked so good in a single player game!

Heroes assemble: Play MARVEL Strike Force, the best RPG today!
